junction.name: Duboce Avenue & Mission Street, San Francisco

claims.text: Duboce Avenue & Mission Street had 14 injury crashes in police records since 2021-10-31: 0 people killed.
These counts are Duboce Avenue & Mission Street's own: the city's record places 24 of the 38 records within 100 m at another intersection or street, and they are left out.
At the U.S. DOT's values that harm costs about $959,000 a year.
93% of crashes here were recorded as “vehicle(s) only involved” crashes, against 57% at the city's worst crash locations.

This corner got continental crosswalks in 2015. Across the city: at 780 sites the change in pedestrian injury crashes (+4%, 95% interval -25% to +33%) could be zero. The city's own record neither shows it worked nor rules it out, so repeating it here rests on other evidence.
The city's painted safety zones: not shown (at 96 sites the change in pedestrian injury crashes (+2%, 95% interval -20% to +34%) could be zero); a second run of the same design on 780 sites agrees.
Backplates with Retroreflective Borders would avoid about 0.4 crashes a year (CMF 1410, the record FHWA's fact sheet cites; evidence: the record FHWA cites), worth $144,000 a year.

Yellow Change Intervals would avoid about 0.2 crashes a year (CMF 4219, the more conservative of the two middle records of 4; evidence: only if a site check confirms it), worth $75,000 a year; check on site: the current yellow plus all-red time is below the ITE recommended practice.
The San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency (SFMTA) is responsible for 13th Street, Duboce Avenue, Otis Street (no route reference, so presumed a city street).
The California Department of Transportation (Caltrans) (route designation only; confirm ownership) is responsible for Mission Street (signed route in OpenStreetMap; owner not confirmed).

A request letter to the San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency (SFMTA) and the California Department of Transportation (Caltrans) (route designation only; confirm ownership) is ready to draft from these facts.
